description: This file defines the RelationshipRepository class within the SuiteCRM JSON API v1 module. It contains a method to determine the relationship type ('to many' or 'to one') based on the provided JSON API request data array.

classes.name: RelationshipRepository
classes.description: Class responsible for handling relationship-related operations in the JSON API layer, currently determining relationship type from request data.

methods.name: getRelationshipTypeFromDataArray
methods.description: Determines whether the relationship is 'to many' or 'to one' based on the structure of the JSON API request data array.
